rules: Large weights stay outside Git and are mounted or generated locally.
Every inference response should expose a stable modelId and modelVersion.
Validation limits must point back to docs/dataset-sources.md and docs/algorithm-verification-report.md.

knownLimits: No committed, labeled patrol-car image or video validation set is available yet.
No mAP, precision, recall, false-positive, or false-negative report is committed yet.
The model version identifies the configured detector; it is not proof of field accuracy.
Prairie Grass validates crosswind spread width only.
BTEX concentration calibration is small-sample and source localization fails the 500 m check.

models.source: Generated from BTEX PANGAEA processed observations
knownLimits: Generated artifact is ignored and must be reproduced locally.
Supports limited concentration-response calibration evidence only.
Does not prove chemical-park CO/NH3/CH4/O2 field telemetry training.
